EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I'm on patrol right now!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}If there's anyone suspicious, I'll
thumb wrestle 'em into submission!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Ahora mismo estoy de patrulla!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Si veo a alguien sospechoso, ¡le
retaré a un duelo de pulgares!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}C'est à mon tour de patrouiller en
ville !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Au premier comportement suspect,
je me tiens prêt à neutraliser
l'individu au combat de pouces !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Sto sorvegliando la città
in questo momento.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Se vedi qualcuno di sospetto, fai
un fischio che ci penso io!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ich bin grad auf Streife!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ich setze meine Muskeln nämlich
für das Gute ein! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Sag mir Bescheid,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}wenn du mal was Auffälliges siehst!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Şu an devriyedeyim!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Şüpheli birini
görürsem başparmak güreşiyle
hizaya getiririm!

IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mmmh... Ho l'impressione di essere
già passato per questa strada.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}A proposito{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dov'è che era
il negozio che cercavo?

EN:
All right!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}} It's another day of working
hard to maintain the peace in this
town!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
¡Muy bien!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}} ¡Aquí estamos otra vez
tratando de mantener la paz en
este pueblo,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
Et voilà !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}} Encore une journée où
mes muscles ont maintenu la paix à
{{TAG:0005:0005:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}La città può dormire sonni tranquilli
quando ci sono i miei muscoli
a fare la guardia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
Tamamdır!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}} Kasabanın huzurunu korumak
için sıkı çalışacağımız yeni bir gün
daha!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I don't know what you're going to
buy, but don't spend too much of
your allowance, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}No sé qué vas a comprar, ¡pero
tampoco te vayas a gastar
toda la paga, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je ne sais pas ce que tu comptes
t'acheter, mais fais attention à ne
pas trop dépenser d'un coup !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non so cosa vuoi comprare, ma
faresti meglio a conservarti un po'
di spiccioli, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Keine Ahnung, was du hier alles
kaufen willst... {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Aber ein paar Sternis
solltest du auch sparen, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ne alacağını bilmiyorum ama harçlığının
hepsini bitirme,{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}¿Has venido hasta aquí para
comprar?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}¿Es porque tienen
algo que te interesa muchísimo?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Tu as fait le chemin jusqu'ici pour
t'acheter quelque chose ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ho ho !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu dois vraiment avoir une
idée précise en tête, alors !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hai fatto tutta questa strada
solo per far compere?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non avete
negozi nella tua città?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Alışveriş için ta buraya kadar
mı geldin?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Demek gerçekten çok istediğin
bir şey var, ha?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Please take your time looking
around the main street in this
town,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ya que estás aquí, tómate el tiempo
que quieras para mirar las tiendas
del pueblo,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Prenditi pure tutto il tempo che
vuoi per ammirare i miei muscoli.
Sono qui per questo,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Bu kasabanın Ana Caddesi'ni doya doya
gez,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}This is my jogging trail!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} The paths
around here are well maintained and
easy to run on!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}¡Esta es la ruta que tomo para
correr!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} ¡Me viene bien que el suelo
esté pavimentado y bien cuidado!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}J'adore faire du jogging dans le
coin !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} C'est tellement plus agréable
de courir sur un sol bien entretenu !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Mi piace correre qui!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} La strada
è pulita, non ci sono buche ed è
il posto perfetto per allenarsi!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Die Einkaufsmeile gehört zu meiner
Jogging-Route!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Die Wege hier sind
in 'nem super Zustand!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Burası benim koşu parkurum!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Yollar
bakımlı, koşması da rahat!

EN:
I like it when the main street is
lively,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} but it's not bad when things
are quiet, either!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
Me gusta cuando la zona comercial
está animada, ¡pero {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}también cuando
está tranquila,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'aime bien l'ambiance de ce
quartier en journée, quand il y a
plein de monde !
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Mais j'avoue qu'il est aussi très
agréable quand l'ambiance est
plus calme,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
Ich mag's ja, wenn die Einkaufsmeile
ruhig ist,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} aber eine Menschenmenge
ist auch toll.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dann laufe ich Slalom!
TRANSLATION:
Ana Cadde'nin hareketli olmasını
seviyorum,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} ama sessizlik de fena
değil!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
